title: Artificial Intelligence in Banking: Revolutionizing Finance and Data Security
description: A guide to AI in banking — from fraud detection and personalised services to secure data management and regulatory compliance.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in Banking, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Banking for bankers, risk teams, fintech readers, and anyone tracking financial infrastructure.
